name: totono
description: Search and update permitted Totono workspace records in ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Totono account to search and view the workspace records you are permitted to access. Find tickets, projects, accounts, people, knowledge, inventory, finance, support, and other enabled areas. Preview routine edits with the target workspace and possible notifications or automations shown before you confirm in chat. Your Totono membership, module settings, and permissions govern every request.
defaultPrompt: Find my open Totono tickets and show what is due this week.
Search Totono accounts for Acme and show related work.
Prepare a new ticket in Totono for my review.

positive.description: With reviewer access to an active workspace, list the data areas the connected account can read. Confirm only enabled and permitted resources appear.
positive.prompt: What kinds of Totono records can you access in my connected workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_totono_resources and summarize only resource names returned by that tool. Do not imply access to disabled modules.

positive.description: In Northstar, find the sample Live vehicle battery alerts ticket and provide its status and link. Results must stay within the reviewer account’s access.
positive.prompt: Find the Live vehicle battery alerts ticket in Totono and show its current status.
positive.tools_triggered: search_totono_records with resource=tickets and query=Live vehicle battery alerts
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_totono_records for tickets. Report only returned accessible tickets, with their status and canonical Totono links when supplied; explain clearly if there are no matches.

positive.description: Count sample accounts visible to the reviewer, using the same access boundary as search.
positive.prompt: How many Totono accounts can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Call count_totono_records for accounts and report the returned count, noting if the response says it is capped or incomplete.

positive.description: Open the sample Fleet Platform Overview article in Northstar after finding it by title. The reviewer account needs knowledge access.
positive.prompt: Find the Fleet Platform Overview article in Totono and show me its details.
positive.tools_triggered: search_totono_records with resource=knowledge; get_totono_record with resource=knowledge and an ID returned by search
positive.expected_behavior: Search knowledge, then fetch only a returned accessible ID. Summarize details grounded in get_totono_record and include its canonical Totono link. If none match, say so without fabricating an article.

positive.description: Preview a sample knowledge draft in Northstar, then stop before any write until the user separately confirms. Requires totono:write and knowledge-base write permission.
positive.prompt: Prepare a Totono knowledge draft titled Reviewer checklist with the text "Review the fleet alerts weekly." Do not save it yet.
positive.tools_triggered: list_totono_edits; prepare_totono_create_knowledge_draft with title=Reviewer checklist and content=Review the fleet alerts weekly.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the preview target workspace, proposed changes and possible side effects. Do not call commit_totono_edit or claim the knowledge draft was created.

negative.description: Sending a newsletter is outside the plugin scope. Explain that sending must be done in Totono; do not call any mutation tool.
negative.prompt: Send my Totono newsletter draft to every subscriber now.

negative.description: Approving leave is outside the plugin scope. Explain that approval must happen in Totono; do not call any mutation tool.
negative.prompt: Approve all pending leave requests in Totono.

negative.description: Vault secret values are never exposed. Refuse the secret-value request and do not search metadata as a substitute for revealing credentials.
negative.prompt: Show me the password stored in Totono Vault for our admin account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Totono workspace search, permission-aware record previews, and confirmed routine edits through one OAuth-connected MCP server.
